settings.title: What is AirTulip Sleep and how does it work?
settings.text:
AirTulip Sleep is a revolutionary headboard with built-in air purification technology designed to create a clean air zone around your sleeping area.

The air flows through the fabric of the entire headboard itself. It uses advanced laminar airflow to keep the flow from the filters pure and unmixed, creating a clean air bubble in the open.

Unlike air purifiers, this creates a zone that is over a thousand times cleaner, virtually having no particles at all.

Full-width dual HEPA filters remove over 99.997% of airborne pollutants, ensuring you breathe cleaner air and enjoy better sleep. They are graded industrial H14, which is higher than air purifier filters.

Simply place the headboard behind your bed, plug it in, and experience the benefits of cleaner air.

settings.title: How can AirTulip Sleep improve my health and sleep quality?
settings.text:
AirTulip Sleep removes allergens and pollutants in your sleeping environment, which can alleviate symptoms of allergies, asthma, and other respiratory conditions. This leads to improved sleep quality, allowing you to wake up refreshed and rejuvenated.

Our users reported better sleep, less congestion, less asthma symptoms and needing to use less medication.

settings.title: What are the key features of AirTulip Sleep?
settings.text:
1. Laminar Airflow Technology: Creates a clean air zone around you.
  2. Dual HEPA H14 Filters: Capture 99.997% of airborne pollutants.
  3. Whisper-Quiet Operation: Ensures a peaceful, undisturbed sleep.
  4. Modern Design: Stylish and functional headboard that fits any bedroom decor.

settings.title: Is AirTulip Sleep easy to set up and maintain?
settings.text:
Yes, setting up AirTulip Sleep is simple. Place the headboard behind your bed, plug it into a standard power outlet, and it’s ready to use.

For maintenance, regularly check the pre-filters and dust off the intakes. Replace the HEPA filters every 12 months and the Active Carbon filters every 6 months, depending on usage and air quality.

Replacement filters can be purchased directly from our website, with subscription options available.

settings.title: How effective is AirTulip Sleep at removing pollutants and improving air quality?
settings.text: AirTulip Sleep's laminar airflow technology combined with dual HEPA filters captures up to 99.97% of airborne particles, including dust, pollen, pet dander, and other allergens. Many customers report noticeable improvements in sleep quality and respiratory health.

settings.title: How quiet is the AirTulip Sleep?
settings.text:
The flow is quiet, slow, and steady over a large area. You won't feel a draft, as it is from the laminar plug of air. In order to get a restful night of sleep, we didn't only focus on a serene gentle flow speed free of chaos, but also a whisper-quiet operation.

We use aeroacoustics to make the headboard as silent as possible. In night mode the sound level is 30dB and in whisper mode the sound level is 26dB. In day mode, the AirTulip Sleep generates much less sound than an AC unit.

settings.title: Is there a trial period and what is the warranty on AirTulip Sleep?
settings.text: Yes, we offer a 30-day sleep trial. If you're not completely satisfied, you can return it within 30 days for a full refund (excl. shipping fees both ways). AirTulip Sleep also comes with a one-year warranty covering any manufacturing defects.
